runtimePolicy.animalProductPolicy: Materials reflect useful biological potential, not guaranteed equal outputs or universal food suitability. Broad groups keep anatomical/sex/life-stage constraints. productEvidenceSources.title: Animal slaughter byproduct utilization
productEvidenceSources.supports: General anatomy/material utilization; not evidence that every wild category is routinely harvested.

productEvidenceSources.title: Poultry species and products
productEvidenceSources.supports: Bird meat, eggs and feathers; wild-bird grouping is a game design abstraction.

productEvidenceSources.title: Utilization and processing of fisheries production
productEvidenceSources.supports: Fish flesh, bones, skin and processed oil.

productEvidenceSources.title: Horns versus antlers
productEvidenceSources.supports: Antlers can be shed; ordinary bovid horns are permanent. Presence depends on anatomy, age and sex.

productEvidenceSources.title: Dairy animals
productEvidenceSources.supports: Practical dairy use requires appropriate managed animals, not all wild mammals.

productEvidenceSources.title: Yak production characteristics
productEvidenceSources.supports: Yak products and harvest of down in managed production.

productEvidenceSources.title: Muskox qiviut
productEvidenceSources.supports: Combing and shed underwool without slaughter.

productEvidenceSources.title: Camels, llamas and alpacas
productEvidenceSources.supports: Camelid meat, fiber and managed camel dairy.

productEvidenceSources.title: Capture, live shearing and release of vicunas
productEvidenceSources.supports: Fiber can be obtained by controlled live capture and release; no automatic domestication.

productEvidenceSources.title: Whales
productEvidenceSources.supports: Baleen is restricted to baleen whales; a broad whale category does not guarantee it.

productEvidenceSources.title: Antarctic krill
productEvidenceSources.supports: Krill have exoskeletons, not vertebrate bones; capture feasibility remains separate.

productEvidenceSources.title: How oysters create pearls
productEvidenceSources.supports: Natural pearl formation is contingent; not every shellfish contains a pearl.

productEvidenceSources.title: Short-beaked echidna
productEvidenceSources.supports: Egg-laying mammal; eggs are carried in a pouch, not an ordinary nest resource.

productEvidenceSources.title: Sinew bow string
productEvidenceSources.supports: Historical material use; raw tendons are distinct from finished sinew cordage.

productEvidenceSources.title: Ossicones
productEvidenceSources.supports: Giraffe/okapi structures are not assigned the generic keratin horn resource.

description.en: Remove flesh, bones and raw fat from a usable carcass; not an automatic reward for sighting or killing.
description.es: Extrae carne, huesos y grasa cruda de un cuerpo aprovechable; no es recompensa automática por avistar o matar.

description.en: Remove an intact skin; tanning is a separate process.
description.es: Retira la piel; curtirla es otro proceso.

description.en: Recover present horns, tusks or baleen; do not assume every individual has them.
description.es: Recupera cuernos, colmillos o barbas presentes; no supone que todos los individuos los tengan.

description.en: Separate useful tendons; cleaning and preparation for cordage remain later processes.
description.es: Separa tendones aprovechables; limpiar y preparar cordelería será otro proceso.

description.en: Gather naturally shed antlers already present; does not remove them from a living animal.
description.es: Recoge astas que ya se desprendieron; no las arranca de un animal vivo.
Recupera plumas después de la muerte.

description.en: Gather feathers already shed; no live plucking.
description.es: Recoge plumas desprendidas; no implica desplumar en vida.

description.en: Requires eggs already present. Removing a fertilized egg can reduce recruitment; reproduction rules remain pending.
description.es: Requiere huevos existentes. Retirar un huevo fecundado puede reducir las crías; reproducción pendiente.

description.en: Requires controlled restraint and a suitable coat; live capture does not imply domestication.
description.es: Requiere sujeción controlada y pelaje apto; capturar no equivale a domesticar.

description.en: Collect loose underwool with appropriate handling; no instant coat regrowth.
description.es: Recoge subpelo disponible con manejo apropiado; no regenera pelaje instantáneamente.

description.en: Gather already shed fiber; material must be present.
description.es: Recoge fibra ya desprendida; el material debe existir.

description.en: Recover suitable hair/underwool from a dead animal; do not also count the same coat as intact fur on a hide.
description.es: Recupera pelo/subpelo apto de un animal muerto; no contar el mismo pelaje también como piel con pelo intacto.

description.en: Only suitable managed lactating females; wild presence does not grant dairy production.
description.es: Solo hembras lactantes apropiadas bajo manejo; presencia silvestre no concede producción lechera.

description.en: Collect accessible droppings at managed husbandry locations.
description.es: Recoge deyecciones accesibles en lugares de manejo ganadero.

description.en: Separate fish flesh, present bony skeleton, skin and fat-bearing tissues.
description.es: Separa carne de pescado, esqueleto óseo presente, piel y tejidos grasos.

description.en: Opening/processing consumes the animal; pearls require an actual pearl-bearing individual.
description.es: Abrir/aprovechar consume al animal; las perlas requieren un individuo que realmente las contenga.

description.en: Collect abandoned empty shells; yields no meat or pearl by itself.
description.es: Recoge conchas vacías; no concede carne ni perlas por sí solo.
